name: Bunkered with Femboy
source:
As an aspiring mobile app developer, you have recently moved into a surprisingly cheap apartment. The apartment turned out to be cheap for a reason, as one unfortunate earthquake drill practically forces you to share your living space with…
Riley, a relatively successful yet insecure graphic designer whose sensitive nature and kindness left him open to harassment, discrimination, and a longing sense for genuine love. Will you unlock Riley's heart, or leave him alone in a desolate world?

[From [url=https://pinktwilight.itch.io/bunkered-with-femboy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为一名有抱负的移动应用程序开发人员，你最近搬进了一套便宜得令人惊讶的公寓。这套公寓之所以便宜是有原因的，因为一次不幸的地震演习实际上迫使你与……分享你的居住空间。
莱利是一位相对成功但缺乏安全感的平面设计师，他敏感的天性和善良让他容易受到骚扰、歧视和对真爱的渴望。你会打开莱利的心扉，还是把他独自留在荒凉的世界里？

[来自[url=https://pinktwilight.itch.io/bunkered-with-femboy]Itch.io[/url]]
